argv: F=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin; for repo in kumitate-shokunin kagi-shokunin tsukuroi-shokunin mado-shokunin; do echo "== $repo reflog events recorded on 2026-10-14 (timestamps UTC)"; git -C "$F/$repo" reflog --date=iso-strict-local --format="%H|%gd|%gs" HEAD | awk 'index($0,"2026-10-14") {print substr($1,1,12) "|" $2 "|" $3}'; done; echo "== tameshi harness commit selected before tick"; c=$(git log --until="2026-10-14T20:00:34Z" -1 --format=%H -- tools/mutate-and-run.sh); echo "commit=$c date=$(git log -1 --format=%cI $c)"; git show "$c:tools/mutate-and-run.sh" | sha256sum; git show "$c:tools/mutate-and-run.sh" | wc -l; echo "== original scratch availability"; for p in /tmp/w9-tameshi-t93/pin-read-final.txt /tmp/w9-tameshi-t93/falsifier /tmp/w9-tameshi-t91/tick.log; do if [ -e "$p" ]; then echo "present $p"; else echo "absent $p"; fi; done; date -u +%FT%TZ
